name: Iwanai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iwanai town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Iwanai, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 16 February 1935.

features.role: Iwanai town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character
